title: Katseye sorry after last-minute Detroit show postponement

blocks.text: Katseye issued an apology to their fans, dubbed as Eyekons, after the group postponed their “WildWorld” concert in Detroit reportedly less than an hour before they were set to take the stage. The global girl group was supposed to perform at Little Caesars Arena on Tuesday, Nov. 3 (Wednesday, Nov. 4 in the Philippines). They cited member Megan Skiendiel’s illness as the reason for the cancellation, although they did not expound. “We’re so sorry to share that tonight’s show at Little Caesars Arena has been postponed due to illness.
